distribution.title: Reconstruct bacterial taxonomy and antibiotic resistance gene diversity in untreated wastewater.

dmp.description: This study aims to characterize the microbiome and resistome signatures in WW from 15 Latvian municipalities, leveraging short-read metagenomic data from untreated waste water samples. To address wider contexts, we explored the impacts on the microbiomes of the WW samples and industrial city environments
